# Permissions

`cinnabar:extension/permissions@0.1.0`

Read-only introspection of this instance's explicitly granted capabilities.

**Grants:** None; querying does not change authority.

## Types

<a id="type-permission"></a>

### `permission`

One named capability on this instance; granted does not describe command-name scope.

```wit
record permission {
    name: string,
    label: string,
    granted: bool,
}
```

| Member | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  |
| `granted` | `bool` |  |

## Functions

<a id="read"></a>

### `read`

```wit
read: func() -> list<permission>;
```

Reads this instance's permission status, including denied capabilities, without a grant.

Types: [`permission`](permissions.md#type-permission).
